messages.text: Ravi here: taking ownership of the Slack setup. The connector can now write to shell-harbor-slack, so outbox posts are live.

Grace here (QA): multi-persona check. If Ravi, Owen and I each show our own name and photo, this test passes.
Jarvis: noted. #82 blocker cleared, the GitHub connector is installed on shell-harbor-slack. Remaining: Robert to OK Ravi as owner.
